Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Students at the local high school often get top marks, as is the case for one Arab girl with parents who are physics teachers and an Asian girl with parents who are physics teachers. The first girl, the Arab one with physics teacher parents, is constantly being forced to work with tutors and study to make sure she graduates at the top of her class, whereas the other one's accomplishments are celebrated by her parents, but they never add extra pressure. Whose parents are supportive of their learning, regardless of grades?
A. The Asian student with physics teacher parents
B. The Arab student with physics teacher parents
C. Not enough information
